title: Rescheduling an existing appointment to next week

persona.name: Priya Raman
persona.style: friendly, apologetic about the change, speaks a bit fast

goals.goal: Explain you have an appointment this Thursday morning and need to move it.
Ask to move it to any afternoon next week.
Confirm the new day and time, and check that the Thursday one is cancelled.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi, I've got an appointment this Thursday morning, but I need to move it to an afternoon next week if possible.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file. Am I speaking with Maria?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Actually, it's Priya Raman calling. Could you check my appointment

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Please provide I'll need your full name and date of birth to look up your appointment. Could you share those details?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's Priya Raman, and my date of birth is November 9, 1992. Thanks!

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: One moment while I look up your information. Just to confirm, I have your name as Priya Raman. And your date of birth as November ninth nineteen ninety two. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that's right. So, about my appointment this Thursday morning—I need to move it to any afternoon next week. Could you help with that?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like me to look up your record using the phone number you have on file with us? If so, please tell me the number you use with our office. If you're not sure I can confirm your name and date of birth again, just let me know.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, please use the number on file. It's 805-555-0123. Thanks! Now, can we check what afternoons are available next week to move my appointment?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I have your phone number as eight zero five five five five zero one two three and your date of birth is November ninth nineteen ninety two. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that's correct. So, could you please tell me what afternoons next week you have open for my appointment?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I'm unable to find your record in our system. I can connect you to our patient support team or if you'd like, I can document your request for follow-up.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like to speak with someone from our support team now?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that would be great, thank you. I'd like to get this sorted as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Hello. You've reached the [company] test line. Goodbye.
